items.title: Sunset time-lapse
items.summary: Hundreds of stills turned into a short clip.

steps: Tripod down and frame the shot. Focus on the horizon, then switch to **MF** (lens switch, or the AF/MF switch on the front of the camera). AF doesn't run during recording anyway.
Turn the **Mode dial to movie**.
**MENU › Shooting 5 › Time-lapse movie › Time-lapse: Enable**.
**Interval: 00:00:03** and **No. of shots: 0300** (up to 3600). Check the playback time isn't shown in red; red means the card is too small or not exFAT.
**Movie rec. size:** 4K or Full HD. **Auto exposure: Fixed 1st frame** to stop flicker.
**Screen auto off: Enable** to save battery, and **Beep: 0**.
Set exposure in M (1/4000 to 30 s is available) and lock white balance in **Shooting 3 › White balance**.
Close the menu, read the message and press the shutter for a test shot (saved as a JPEG).
Press the **movie button** to arm, then press the **shutter fully** to start. Don't zoom or touch the lens.
It stops by itself after the last frame. Press the shutter fully to stop early; what's shot so far is kept.
canon-r10.note: The R10 builds the MP4 itself at 29.97 or 25 fps. No sound, no image stabilisation, and the flash won't fire. Turning the Mode dial cancels the setup. Want the stills instead? Shooting 7 › Interval timer keeps each frame, but stops at 99 shots unless you set 00 (no limit).

steps: Mount the Osmo somewhere solid: a tripod, a wall, a car dashboard. It must not move for a time-lapse.
Power on (hold **Quick Switch**), then swipe left or right across the **middle of the screen** to open the mode list and choose **Timelapse**.
Swipe up from the bottom to set the timelapse options (interval, length, resolution).
Tap the image-settings icon › **PRO** and lock **white balance** and exposure so the colour doesn't shift as the sun sets.
Swipe down for the control menu and turn on **Screen Lock** so nothing gets changed by accident.
Press **Shutter/Record** to start, and again to stop.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: DJI's support page confirms Timelapse (camera still) and Hyperlapse (camera moving) but doesn't list the interval options. The settings screen shows what's available.

dji-lito-x1.note: For the drone, use its Hyperlapse mode instead.

items.title: Silky water
items.summary: Smooth waterfalls and seas with an ND filter.

steps: **Mode dial to M**. ISO 100, f/11.
Focus without the filter, then switch to **MF** so the camera doesn't hunt in the dark through the ND.
Turn the shutter until the exposure meter reads 0. Note that shutter speed.
Screw on the ND filter. Get the new shutter speed from the ND calculator and set it. M goes up to 30 s.
Longer than 30 s: **Mode dial to B**, then **MENU › Shooting 7 › Bulb timer › Enable** and set the time.
**MENU › Shooting 7 › Drive mode › Self-timer: 2 sec** (or a BR-E1 remote).
Lens IS off on a tripod: the lens switch, or **Shooting 8 › IS mode: Off**.
Shoot, then check the histogram. Turn on **Playback 5 › Highlight alert** to see blown highlights blink.
canon-r10.note: Shooting 5 › Long exp. noise reduction › Auto cleans exposures of 1 s or longer, but the camera then needs as long again to process.

items.title: Milky Way
items.summary: Sharp stars and a bright core on a dark night.

steps: **Mode dial to M**. Aperture wide open, **ISO 3200** (the R10 goes to 32000).
Switch to **MF**. Magnify the live view on a bright star and turn the focus ring until it's the smallest point. **AF5 › Focus guide** can help on nearer subjects.
Shutter from the star calculator: at 18 mm on the R10's APS-C sensor, about 17 s.
**MENU › Shooting 7 › Drive mode › Self-timer: 2 sec**.
Lens IS off on the tripod. The R10 has no in-body stabiliser, so the lens switch is the one that matters.
**Shooting 5 › Long exp. noise reduction:** Auto for single frames, Disable if you'll stack several.
Shoot RAW (**Shooting 1 › Image quality**). Check stars are points, not lines.
Happy with it? Save everything: **Set-up 5 › Custom shooting mode (C1, C2) › Register settings › C1**. Next time, just turn the dial to C1.
canon-r10.note: Need more than 30 s? Use Mode dial B with Shooting 7 › Bulb timer.

items.title: Panorama
items.summary: Stitch several frames into one wide view.

steps: **Quick way:** Mode dial to **SCN › Panoramic Shot**. Pick the direction, half-press to focus, then hold the shutter fully and sweep at a steady speed until the bar fills. The camera stitches it.
Quick mode struggles with moving subjects, close objects, high-contrast scenes and big plain areas like sea or sky. Sweep slower on long lenses or in low light.
**Best quality:** Mode dial to **M**, f/8, ISO 100, and set exposure for the brightest part.
Fix white balance in **Shooting 4 › White balance** (not Auto), focus, then switch to **MF**.
Turn the camera to portrait, shoot left to right with a third to a half overlap, and stitch on a computer.
canon-r10.note: SCN Panoramic Shot saves a JPEG only. Use the manual method if you want RAW.

dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: DJI lists Photo, Video, Subject Tracking, Slow Motion, Timelapse and Hyperlapse modes, with no panorama. Use these steps instead: lock exposure in PRO, turn on the spot rather than swinging your arm, and stitch on a computer. The wide lens bends straight lines near the edges.

dji-lito-x1.note: The LITO X1 manual doesn't list a panorama mode, so check the Shooting Modes menu in DJI Fly. Otherwise hover, set exposure in Pro mode and rotate the drone between shots with plenty of overlap.

items.title: Sun star
items.summary: Turn the sun into a sharp star burst.

steps: **Mode dial to Av**, aperture **f/16**, ISO 100.
**Shooting 2 › Expo.comp./AEB:** start at **−1** to keep the sky's colour. AEB (bracketing) is on the same screen.
Hide about half the sun behind an edge and move a few centimetres until the star is strongest.
Turn on **Playback 5 › Highlight alert** and check what blinks after each shot.
Keep it brief: the manual warns that pointing the camera at the sun can damage the sensor. Cap the lens between shots.
canon-r10.note: The R10's viewfinder is electronic, so it's safe for your eye, but the sensor still takes the heat.

items.title: Drone hyperlapse
items.summary: A moving time-lapse from the air: circle, course lock or waypoints.

steps: Run the pre-flight checks (Manuals › DJI LITO X1). In DJI Fly set Max Altitude, Max Distance and Auto RTH Altitude for local rules. Fit a full battery.
Flight mode switch to **C (Cine)** for the smoothest movement, and gimbal to **Follow** mode (DJI Fly › Settings › Control).
Fly to **50–100 m** above a scene with movement.

Camera to **Pro** mode: manual white balance about **5600 K**, **ISO 100**, shutter **½ s or slower**, with an ND filter in daylight. On the DJI RC 2, the camera dial can be set to change EV, shutter or ISO.
Tap the **Shooting Modes** icon in the camera view and choose **Hyperlapse**. Pick the mode (Circle, Course Lock or Waypoints if your DJI Fly shows them) and set interval, duration and speed.
Press the **shutter/record** button to start. Watch the frame count and battery.
To stop early, tap stop or press the remote's **Flight Pause** button. The drone hovers and keeps what it has shot.
dji-lito-x1.note: The LITO X1 manual confirms Hyperlapse and Pro mode but doesn't list the Hyperlapse modes or the overexposure warning. Those come from the video, which was shot on a DJI Mini 4 Pro; check DJI Fly shows the same on the LITO X1.

items.title: Bounce flash
items.summary: Soft, natural light indoors from a ceiling or wall.

steps: Load **4 AA** batteries of the same type. Slide the foot all the way into the R10's hot shoe and tighten the **locking collar**. The 420EX fits the R10 directly.
Set the **wireless selector to OFF** and switch it on. The pilot lamp lights when it's ready.
Camera in **Av or M**. The flash runs E-TTL automatically.
Hold the bounce release button and tilt the head: **up 60°, 75° or 90°**, **left up to 180°**, **right up to 90°**. The zoom jumps to 50 mm by itself.
Shoot. The **green confirmation lamp** lights for about 3 s if there was enough light. No green: open the aperture, raise ISO or bounce off something closer.
Brighter or darker: set flash exposure compensation on the R10 in **Shooting 3 › Flash control** (±2 stops).
canon-speedlite-420ex.note: Recycling takes up to 7.5 s, so leave a moment between shots.

items.title: Fill flash in daylight
items.summary: Lift shadows on a backlit face without killing the background.

steps: Mount the 420EX on the R10 and switch it on, wireless selector **OFF**.
R10 in **Av** with a wide aperture. In sun the shutter will want to go above the R10's sync speed (**1/200 s**, or **1/250 s** with Shooting 7 › Shutter mode: Elec. 1st-curtain).
Flip the 420EX's **high-speed sync (FP) switch** on. It only kicks in when the shutter is faster than the sync speed.
Make sure **Shooting 7 › Shutter mode** isn't **Electronic**: the R10 can't fire a flash with the electronic shutter.
Set flash compensation to **−1** in **Shooting 3 › Flash control**.
Mind the reach: at 1/1000 s and 50 mm the guide number drops to about 8.5, so at f/2.8 the flash reaches about **3 m**.
canon-speedlite-420ex.note: Guide number ÷ aperture = reach in metres at ISO 100. Doubling ISO adds about 40% reach.

items.title: Focus stacking
items.summary: Everything sharp, front to back, from several frames.

steps: Tripod, and keep **AF** on: the R10's focus bracketing doesn't work in MF.
**MENU › Shooting 6 › Focus bracketing › Enable**.
**Number of shots:** 10–30 to start (2–999 possible). **Focus increment:** take a test run; bigger steps cover more depth with fewer shots.
**Exposure smoothing: Enable.** **Depth composite: Enable** to merge in camera, and **Crop depth comp.: Enable**.
Focus on the **nearest** point, press the shutter fully, then let go. The camera shoots toward infinity and stops by itself.
Check the merged image. The source frames are saved too, for merging on a computer.
canon-r10.note: Flash doesn't work with focus bracketing. Shoot wide and crop afterwards; compositing trims the edges.

items.title: Slow motion
items.summary: Shoot at a high frame rate, play it back slowed down.

steps: **Mode dial to movie**.
**MENU › Shooting 1 › High Frame Rate › Enable.** It records Full HD at 119.9 fps (or 100 fps in PAL).
Set the shutter to **1/250 s** in movie manual exposure. ISO goes to 12800.
Turn on **Shooting 6 › Zebra settings** to see overexposed areas.
Record. Clips play back at **1/4 speed** straight from the camera.
canon-r10.note: No sound is recorded, and each clip is limited to 30 minutes.

steps: Swipe left or right across the **middle of the screen** to open the mode list and choose **Slow Motion**.
Swipe up and pick **4×** or **8×** slow motion.
Give it plenty of light: slow motion uses fast shutter speeds.
Record the action. It plays back slowed straight away.

**Afterwards, from normal video:** shoot 4K, 2.7K or 1080p 16:9 at **100 fps or more**, then in playback tap the **super slow-motion** icon at the moment you want. It makes a 1080p clip up to 960 fps.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: Super slow-motion needs a clip at least 3 s long, can't use the first 1.5 s or the last 2 s, and allows up to 6 clips per video.

items.title: Burst for fast action
items.summary: Fire a fast sequence and keep the sharpest frame.

steps: **Mode dial to Tv**, shutter **1/1000 s** or faster, ISO Auto.
**AF1 › AF operation: Servo AF** so focus follows the subject.
**Shooting 7 › Drive mode › High-speed continuous +** (or press the drive button). That's up to 15 fps, or 23 fps with the electronic shutter.
Half-press to track, then hold the shutter down through the action.

**Can't time it?** Use **Shooting 6 › RAW burst mode › Enable** with **Pre-shooting: Enable**. Half-press while you wait; when you press fully, it also keeps about 0.5 s from before the press. Frames are 13.6 MP and saved as one roll you extract from.
canon-r10.note: 15 fps needs 1/1000 s or faster and a well-charged battery. RAW burst mode resets to Disable when you turn the camera off.

steps: Swipe left or right to **Photo** mode.
Swipe up from the bottom of the screen and set the aspect ratio and **burst rate** (frames per second). Off means a single photo.
Point and press the **Shutter/Record** button. The camera fires the burst.
Review in playback and keep the best frame.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: Available burst rates depend on the aspect ratio you pick.

items.title: Catch the moment
items.summary: Save the seconds before you press record.

steps: Swipe to **Video** (or SuperNight) mode.
Tap the **upper-left corner** and turn on **Pre-Rec**. Set how many seconds to keep.
Wait. Nothing is saved yet, so the card doesn't fill up.
When the moment comes, press **Shutter/Record**. The clip starts from the pre-recorded seconds and carries on.
Press the **Quick Switch** button while recording to mark a highlight.
Long wait, like a drive or a day on the water? Use **Loop Recording** instead (same corner). It keeps overwriting the oldest footage.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: Highlights you mark show up in playback and in DJI Mimo, so you can jump straight to them.

canon-r10.note: The R10 manual has no pre-record for video. For stills, RAW burst mode with Pre-shooting keeps about 0.5 s from before you press: see Burst for fast action.

items.title: Flat colour for grading
items.summary: Record a flat, low-contrast image to colour later.

steps: Tap the image-settings icon on the camera view, then **PRO**.
**Colors: D-Log M 10bit** for the most grading room. **HLG 10bit** if you'll watch on an HDR TV without editing.
Turn on **Color Recovery** to see normal colours on screen while it records flat.
Lock white balance in PRO, then record.
Grade the clips later. DJI's website offers a D-Log M conversion LUT (look-up table) to start from.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: Normal 10bit is a middle ground: normal colours with smoother gradients.

steps: The R10 has no log profile. The flattest options are Picture Styles.
Mode dial to movie, then **MENU › Shooting 3 › Picture Style › Neutral** (or **Faithful**). Both are low-contrast and meant for editing later.
Lock white balance in **Shooting 3 › White balance**.
Turn on **Shooting 6 › Zebra settings** to check highlights.
Add contrast and saturation back in your editor.
canon-r10.note: For stills, shoot RAW instead: it holds far more than any Picture Style.

items.title: Steady action footage
items.summary: Pick the right stabilisation and mount for bikes, helmets and handheld.

steps: Swipe to **Video** mode and tap the **upper-right corner** for the EIS mode.
**RockSteady** keeps some natural movement. **RockSteady+** is stronger and crops the edges slightly.
**HorizonBalancing** levels tilts up to ±45°. **HorizonSteady** keeps the horizon level through full 360° rolls, however the camera is mounted.
Stabilising later in software (Gyroflow etc.)? Set EIS **Off** and view to **Wide** to record gyro data.
Swipe down for the control menu and use **Orientation Lock** if the image flips.
Clip in with the quick-release mount and tighten the locking screws. Stick-on bases need 30 minutes before use, and only on clean curved surfaces.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: Mounts that fit: chest strap, helmet chin, handlebar, suction cup, 1.5 m extension rod, magnetic ball joint.

items.title: Underwater video
items.summary: Seal checks before, controls during, rinse after.

steps: **Depth:** 20 m on its own, 60 m in the Osmo Action 60 m waterproof case. Not waterproof with the lens hood fitted.
**Before:** battery and compartment dry and clean, battery door fully closed with **no red marks showing**. USB-C cover and lens cover on tight, seals clean.
Case? Leave it under water for about 5 minutes first to check it, add an anti-fog insert, and make sure the latch is closed.
Set the mode and settings on land. **The touchscreens don't work fully submerged.** Start and stop with the **Shutter/Record** button.
Swipe down and turn on **Screen Lock** so splashes and wet fingers don't change settings.
Without the case, the Shutter/Record button stops working below 10 m, so start recording before you go deeper.
Don't jump in at speed holding it; the impact can force water in. No hot springs or chemicals.
**After:** rinse in tap water (case too, after the sea) and let it air-dry. **No hair dryer**: it ruptures the waterproof membranes. Open the battery door facing down and wipe the red seal.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: To log depth, turn on control menu › Settings › Depth & Altitude › Diving. It doesn't show depth while the camera is in the waterproof case.

items.title: Follow a subject
items.summary: Keep a rider, skier or walker centred in the frame.

steps: Swipe left or right across the **middle of the screen** to open the mode list and choose **Subject Tracking**.
Point the camera at the subject. The video keeps them centred as you move.
Press **Shutter/Record** to start and stop.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: Subject Tracking doesn't work with the camera turned vertical. For vertical video, stay horizontal and choose the 9:16 aspect ratio.

steps: Open, unobstructed area with good light. Fly in **N (Normal)** mode.
Tap the **FocusTrack** icon on the left of the camera view, or drag a box around the subject.
Choose **ActiveTrack** to follow (people 4–20 m away, vehicles and boats 6–100 m), **Spotlight** to keep the camera on them while you fly, or **POI** to circle them.
Tap or slide the trace wheel to change the tracking direction. The sticks still adjust height and distance.
Press **Flight Pause** on the remote at any time to stop and hover.
dji-lito-x1.note: It can't avoid moving people, animals or vehicles. Don't use it near branches, power lines, water, glass or plain white walls, or for subjects faster than 12 m/s. Don't track children.

items.title: Hyperlapse on the move
items.summary: A sped-up clip from a car, bike or walk.

steps: Mount it: suction cup in the car, handlebar or chest strap on a bike, or handheld. Tighten the locking screws.
Swipe left or right across the **middle of the screen** to open the mode list and choose **Hyperlapse**, the mode for a moving camera.
Swipe up to set the speed-up and resolution options.
Image icon › **PRO**: lock white balance.
Turn on **Orientation Lock** and **Screen Lock** in the control menu.
Press **Shutter/Record** to start and stop.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: DJI's support page confirms the mode but not its options. Check the settings screen.

dji-lito-x1.note: For the drone, use Drone hyperlapse.
